The user wants to know the result of the multiplication $19 \times 23$.
    The instruction specifies to reply with *only* the integer.

    Method 1: Standard multiplication
    $19 \times 23 = (20 - 1) \times 23$
    $= 20 \times 23 - 1 \times 23$
    $= 460 - 23$
    $= 437$

    Method 2: Algebraic identity $(a-b)(a+b) = a^2 - b^2$
    $19 = 21 - 2$
    $23 = 21 + 2$
    $19 \times 23 = (21 - 2)(21 + 2) = 21^2 - 2^2$
    $21^2 = 441$
    $2^2 = 4$
    $441 - 4 = 437$

    Method 3: $19 \times 23 = 19 \times (20 + 3)$
    $= 19 \times 20 + 19 \times 3$
    $= 380 + 57$
    $= 437$

    Result: 437.
    Constraint check: Reply with *only* the integer.

    Integer: 437.
